instructionalContract.applicationProblemText:
Antonio works on his project for 4 thirds hours. His mom tells him that he must spend another 2 thirds of an
hour on it. Draw a number bond and number line with copies of thirds to show how long Antonio needs to
work altogether. Write the amount of time Antonio needs to work altogether as a whole number.


Note: This problem reviews placing fractions on a number line, using number bonds to compose fractions,
and representing whole number fractions as whole numbers.

Application Problem (6 minutes)

Antonio works on his project for 4 thirds hours. His mom tells him that he must spend another 2 thirds of an
hour on it. Draw a number bond and number line with copies of thirds to show how long Antonio needs to
work altogether. Write the amount of time Antonio needs to work altogether as a whole number.


Note: This problem reviews placing fractions on a number line, using number bonds to compose fractions,
and representing whole number fractions as whole numbers.
